arguments.title: Clinical Medication Safety and Adherence Platform
arguments.spec:
# Clinical Medication Safety and Adherence Platform — requirements

Decision support for small clinics, home-care nurses, and family caregivers. NOT diagnosis or prescribing.
- Typed domain model (patient, medication-as-concept, schedule, prescriber, pharmacy, caregiver, adherence event) with stable branded ids and an append-only audit history.
- Medication reconciliation comparing imported, patient-reported, and clinician-approved lists; every input keeps source provenance and lands in accepted/rejected/unmatched (totality — nothing vanishes). Unresolvable free text is a first-class BLOCKING unmatched state.
- Concept normalization over an RxNorm-shaped fixture graph (text/brand/NDC -> SCD -> IN); combination products (MIN) decompose to ingredients before any rule runs.
- Rule engine: duplicate active ingredient, therapeutic-class duplication, max daily dose (unit-safe, frequency-folded), allergy with side-chain-graded beta-lactam cross-reactivity, contraindication. Alerts are typed, severity-tiered (interruptive vs passive), evidence-bearing, suppressible within a severity ceiling (contraindicated is never suppressible).
- Suppression memory with provenance (who/when/scope/reason) and expiry on an injected clock.
- Adherence calendar (taken/missed/skipped-by-instruction/held-by-clinician/unknown) and refill-exhaustion forecast, both timezone-deterministic on an injected Clock; clinician holds extend supply.
- Task queue (caregiver follow-up / clinician review / refill request / patient education) where every task traces to facts and rule evidence.
- Plain-language patient summary that never leaks raw scores or clinical directives (denylist-enforced).
- Deterministic seed data: five patients with conflicting histories + the adversarial E4 fixtures. npm test green with zero network.
arguments.plan:
# Implementation plan

Strict dependency order; foundations before workflows, workflows before presentation.
1. Scaffold + core types + injected Clock (s00-s02).
2. Unit-safe dose arithmetic; RxNorm fixture graph; concept resolver with blocking unmatched state; versioned ReferencePack; append-only AuditLog (s03-s08).
3. Shared rule contracts, then the five rules as separate pure modules, then the evaluateRules facade that filters to active items once (s09-s15).
4. Suppression memory: ceiling, audit integration, expiry, fuzz invariant (s16-s19).
5. Reconciliation with totality + property test (s20-s21).
6. Adherence calendar + TZ determinism; refill forecast + held-medication scenario (s22-s25).
7. Task queue + traceability; patient summary + denylist negatives (s26-s29).
8. Seeded patients, adversarial fixtures, flagship integration test (s30-s32).
9. Breadth per the spec recipes: class breadth (s33-s35), audit projections (s36), knowledge-debt ledger (s37), LASA rule (s38), FHIR-shaped import adapter (s39), README (s40).
Every card ships its own tests; npm test is the acceptance command everywhere; no Date.now(), no Math.random(), no network.
arguments.summary: Build the safety spine first — types, clock, dose units, concept resolver, reference pack, audit log — then the five evidence-bearing rules and their facade, then suppression memory, reconciliation, adherence/refill projections, the task queue, and the guarded patient summary, finishing with seeded patients, adversarial fixtures, and a flagship integration test. Breadth cards extend classes, projections, LASA, and a FHIR-shaped import adapter.

tasks.title: Project scaffold: strict TypeScript and Vitest wiring
tasks.prompt: Create the npm scaffold: package.json (private, type module, test script = vitest run --passWithNoTests), tsconfig.json with strict true and noImplicitAny, and vitest.config.ts including test/**/*.test.ts. npm test must exit 0 before any feature card lands. No runtime dependencies.

tasks.title: Core branded domain types
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/types.ts with the exact S01 exports: branded string ids (PatientId, MedicationConceptId, PrescriberId, PharmacyId, CaregiverId, RuleId), ReferencePack, InteractionPair, TherapeuticClassEntry, BetaLactamSideChainEntry, DoseCeiling, RxNormNode, AlertSeverity, DiscrepancyClass, AdherenceState, TaskType. Add a compile-only test/types.test.ts that imports every type and assigns literals.

tasks.title: Injected Clock interface and FixedClock
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/clock.ts exporting interface Clock { now(): Date } and src/core/fixed-clock.ts exporting class FixedClock implements Clock returning a CLONE of the fixed time on every call. test/fixed-clock.test.ts asserts the ISO string and that two now() calls return equal values but distinct object references. No Date.now() anywhere in production code.

tasks.title: Unit-safe dose and quantity arithmetic
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/dose.ts per S03: DoseUnit/FrequencyUnit/WeightUnit, Quantity, Weight, toKg (1 kg = 2.2 lb), frequencyToDailyMultiplier (as-needed -> null), dailyDoseMg folding frequency and weight, and UnitMismatchError. Any unit the function cannot handle must THROW UnitMismatchError, never coerce silently. test/dose.test.ts covers lb->kg, every-6h=4, 500mg qid=2000, 10mg/kg bid at 70kg=1400, missing-weight throw, and as-needed null.
tasks.knowledgeDebt: mg/m2 BSA dosing and renal-interval adjustment are not modeled; a later card must add explicit, pharmacist-reviewed conversion hooks instead of widening this arithmetic.

tasks.title: RxNorm-shaped fixture graph
tasks.prompt: Create src/fixtures/rxnorm-graph.ts exporting FIXTURE_RXNORM_GRAPH: RxNormNode[] with Fluoxetine (IN/PIN/SCD, Prozac SBD), Acetaminophen (IN/SCD, Tylenol SBD), Hydrocodone (IN/SCD), the Acetaminophen/Hydrocodone MIN listing both ingredient INs, Amoxicillin, Cephalexin, Aztreonam (IN+SCD each), and one NDC node mapping up to the Acetaminophen SCD. Free text like 'a water pill' must NOT be in the graph, by design.

tasks.title: MedicationConceptResolver with unmatched blocking state
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/medication-concept-resolver.ts per S04: resolve(input) matches exact rxcui, then case-insensitive name, then substring; ambiguity or no match returns { unmatched: { inputText, reason, blocksReconciliation: true } } — never a silent drop. getIngredients decomposes MIN/SCD/SBD to IN-level rxcuis. Tests cover Tylenol -> SBD, case-insensitive SCD lookup, 'a water pill' -> unmatched, and MIN decomposition to both INs.
tasks.knowledgeDebt: Real NDC mapping has obsolete/repackager ambiguity the fixture graph cannot express; the unmatched/ambiguous path is the extension point and its limits are recorded debt.
acceptanceChecks: 'a water pill' resolves to unmatched with blocksReconciliation true
the Acetaminophen/Hydrocodone MIN decomposes to both ingredient INs
nonGoals: No live RxNorm/NDC directory calls; the fixture graph is the only source

tasks.title: Resolver ambiguity and NDC lookup tests
tasks.prompt: Add test/medication-concept-resolver-ambiguity.test.ts: an ambiguous substring (e.g. 'oral' matching many nodes) returns unmatched with reason 'ambiguous'; resolving the fixture NDC code returns the Acetaminophen SCD lineage (getIngredients yields the Acetaminophen IN); an empty string is unmatched not-found. No production changes.

tasks.title: Versioned ReferencePack fixture
tasks.prompt: Create src/fixtures/reference-pack.ts exporting FIXTURE_REFERENCE_PACK (version 0.1.0-fixture, source illustrative-fixture, confidence illustrative) with: the Fluoxetine+Hydrocodone serious interaction (serotonin-syndrome evidence note), one contraindicated pair for the ceiling tests, SSRI and opioid therapeutic classes, beta-lactam side chains (amoxicillin aminopenicillin/high, cephalexin aminocephalosporin/moderate, aztreonam monobactam/low), and the Acetaminophen 4000 maxDailyMg ceiling sourced 'FDA label'. Tests pin confidence, the aztreonam low risk, and the 4000 ceiling.
tasks.knowledgeDebt: Every entry is an illustrative deterministic subset, NOT clinical truth; production packs are licensed (FDB/Medi-Span) and need pharmacist sign-off before any 'clinically validated' claim.

tasks.title: Append-only AuditLog
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/audit-log.ts per S06: AuditEventType union, AuditEvent, and class AuditLog with append (deterministic counter ids), getAll, getByPatient — returned arrays are copies so callers cannot mutate history. Tests assert sequential ids '1'/'2', insertion order, patient filtering, and immutability of the returned array.

tasks.title: Alert and rule-input type contracts
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/rule-types.ts with the S07 contracts shared by all five rules: EvidenceRef, Alert (ruleId, severity, interruptive, evidence, suppressible, suppressionScope, recommendedAction, involvedDrugs), PatientFacts (weightKg?, allergyIngredients, allergyClasses), RegimenItem (conceptId, resolvedIngredients, dose, frequency, status active|held|stopped), plus severityToInterruptive helper (contraindicated/serious => true). Compile-only usage lands in the per-rule cards.

tasks.title: Duplicate-ingredient rule with MIN decomposition
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/rules/dup-ingredient.ts: checkDuplicateIngredient(regimen, pack) fires a moderate 'dup-ingredient' alert when two ACTIVE items share an IN after decomposition (resolvedIngredients overlap) — the combo-pill blind spot must be caught. Evidence cites the pack version. Test: MIN combo + standalone Acetaminophen fires; two unrelated items do not.

tasks.title: Therapeutic-class duplication rule
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/rules/dup-class.ts: checkClassDuplication(regimen, pack) fires an informational 'dup-class' alert when two ACTIVE items resolve into the same ReferencePack therapeutic class (match members against resolvedIngredients). Evidence names the class. Test with two SSRI items firing and an SSRI+opioid pair staying silent.

tasks.title: Max-daily-dose rule with frequency folding
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/rules/max-dose.ts: checkMaxDailyDose(facts, regimen, pack) computes each ACTIVE item's daily mg via dailyDoseMg (folding frequency, using facts.weightKg for weight-based units) and fires a serious 'max-dose' alert when a pack doseCeiling for a resolved ingredient is exceeded. UnitMismatchError must propagate, never be swallowed. Test: APAP 1500mg qid (6000/day) fires against the 4000 ceiling; 500mg bid does not; as-needed items are skipped.

tasks.title: Allergy rule with beta-lactam cross-reactivity
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/rules/allergy.ts: checkAllergy(facts, regimen, pack) fires 'allergy' alerts — exact IN match in facts.allergyIngredients => serious; otherwise beta-lactam side-chain cross-reactivity via pack (patient allergic to amoxicillin: cephalexin/moderate => moderate alert, aztreonam/low => informational, NOT serious). Keyed by sideChainGroup risk, never by name matching. Tests cover all three gradings.
tasks.knowledgeDebt: The side-chain cross-reactivity table is a starting model; recent literature says historical estimates over-stated risk — allergist review required before any clinical use.

tasks.title: Contraindication rule with unsuppressible severity
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/rules/contraindication.ts: checkContraindication(regimen, pack) scans pack.interactions for ACTIVE ingredient pairs; a pack severity of 'contraindicated' fires with suppressible false, anything else ('serious' etc.) fires suppressible true. Evidence quotes the pack entry. Tests: fluoxetine+linezolid => contraindicated and unsuppressible; fluoxetine+hydrocodone => serious and suppressible.

tasks.title: evaluateRules facade over the five rules
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/rule-engine.ts: evaluateRules(facts, regimen, pack) filters the regimen to status 'active' ONCE, then concatenates dup-ingredient, dup-class, max-dose, allergy, and contraindication results (pure function, no I/O). Held/stopped items must never reach any rule. test/rule-engine.test.ts re-runs the S07 acceptance table: SSRI duplication, APAP 6000 over-ceiling, amoxicillin exact allergy, cephalexin moderate cross-reactivity, aztreonam informational, contraindicated pair unsuppressible, held item silent, and evidence.length >= 1 on every alert.
acceptanceChecks: held medications produce zero alerts across all five rules

tasks.title: SuppressionStore with severity ceiling
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/suppression-store.ts per S08: SuppressionRecord (scope this-patient|always-for-pair, provenance who/when/reason) and SuppressionStore.record throwing SuppressionCeilingError for contraindicated alerts; isSuppressed matches ruleId + sorted involvedDrugs + scope. Tests: moderate suppression suppresses for the same patient, ceiling throw, different patient not suppressed under this-patient scope, always-for-pair suppresses for any patient.

tasks.title: Suppression audit-event integration
tasks.prompt: Extend SuppressionStore.record with an optional auditLog parameter: every successful suppression appends exactly one 'alert-suppressed' AuditEvent (actor = suppressedBy, payload carries ruleId/scope/reason). A ceiling rejection appends NOTHING. test/suppression-audit.test.ts pins one-event-per-record and zero events on the contraindicated throw.

tasks.title: Suppression expiry on the injected clock
tasks.prompt: Add expiresAt?: Date to SuppressionRecord (optional expiry argument on record); isSuppressed takes the evaluating clock and returns false once clock.now() > expiresAt. test/suppression-expiry.test.ts: a suppression that expired yesterday no longer suppresses; one expiring tomorrow still does.

tasks.title: Suppression ceiling fuzz invariant
tasks.prompt: Add test/suppression-invariant.test.ts: with a seeded LCG (seed 42, no Math.random), generate 50 random suppression/query pairs across severities and scopes and assert a 'contraindicated' alert is NEVER suppressed — record() must throw for every contraindicated attempt and isSuppressed must never return true for one. Pure test card.

tasks.title: Reconciliation workflow with source provenance
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/reconciliation.ts per S09: MedicationSource, ReconciliationItem (conceptId nullable, inputText, source, provenance), Discrepancy, and pure reconcile(items, resolver, clinicianApprovedIds, clock) -> { accepted, rejected, unmatched, discrepancies }. TOTALITY is the law: every input lands in exactly one of accepted/rejected/unmatched with provenance preserved — resolver-unmatched items go to unmatched (blocking), never dropped. Classify conservative 'unintentional' when in doubt; clinician-approved items absent from imports classify 'intentional-documented'.

tasks.title: Reconciliation totality property test
tasks.prompt: Add test/reconciliation-totality.test.ts: with a seeded LCG generate 30 random input mixes (resolvable names, ambiguous substrings, junk text across all three sources) and assert inputs.length === accepted+rejected+unmatched for every mix, plus no item appears in two buckets (disjointness by inputText+source identity). Pure test card.

tasks.title: Adherence calendar summary
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/adherence-calendar.ts per S10: AdherenceEvent and summarizeAdherence(events, patientId, conceptId, periodStart, periodEnd) counting taken/missed/skippedByInstruction/heldByClinician/unknown over [periodStart, periodEnd) — pure counts, no percentages, no Date.now(). Tests: a 10-event set counts exactly, out-of-period events are excluded, and two identical calls are deeply equal.

tasks.title: Adherence timezone-determinism property
tasks.prompt: Add test/adherence-determinism.test.ts: run summarizeAdherence over the same UTC event log with process.env.TZ swapped across UTC, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo, and Australia/Eucla (via vitest per-test TZ shim: construct Dates from fixed UTC ISO strings and compare JSON.stringify outputs) — the summaries must be byte-identical because all boundaries are UTC instants, not local days. Also assert a DST-boundary week (2025-03-09) is stable.

tasks.title: Refill-exhaustion forecast on the injected clock
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/refill-forecast.ts per S11: forecastRefill(conceptId, lastFillDate, remainingQuantityMg, dose, frequency, knownHoldDays, clock, weightKg?) -> RefillForecast. Hold days extend supply (adjustedRemaining = remaining + holdDays*dailyDose); projectedExhaustionDate anchors to lastFillDate; daysUntilExhaustion floors against clock.now(); isAtRisk <= 7 days; as-needed yields nulls and isAtRisk false. Tests: 100mg at 10mg/day clock at +5d => ~5 days left; +7 hold days shifts the date 7 days; as-needed returns nulls.
tasks.knowledgeDebt: Renal/hepatic dose adjustment and partial fills are not modeled; the forecast assumes constant consumption between fills. Flagged for pharmacist review before production use.

tasks.title: Held-medication refill forecast scenario
tasks.prompt: Add test/refill-forecast-held.test.ts (worked example C): a medication with 10 days of remaining supply plus a 7-day clinician hold must project exhaustion 17 days out from the fill anchor — isAtRisk false, daysUntilExhaustion > 10 — and adding a hold must NEVER shorten days-of-supply (refill monotonicity, one seeded sweep).

tasks.title: Safety task queue with audit trail
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/task-queue.ts per S12: SafetyTask and TaskQueue.createFromAlert (contraindicated/serious => clinician-review, moderate => caregiver-follow-up, informational => patient-education; traceToFacts from involvedDrugs) and createFromRefillRisk (isAtRisk => refill-request). Every creation appends exactly one 'task-created' AuditEvent; ids are counter-deterministic. Tests: serious alert => clinician-review task; at-risk forecast => refill-request; one audit event each; traceToFacts non-empty.

tasks.title: Task-to-evidence traceability test
tasks.prompt: Add test/task-traceability.test.ts: run evaluateRules over a conflicted regimen, feed every alert into TaskQueue.createFromAlert, and assert each resulting task's traceToFacts references only drug ids present in the source regimen and each evidenceAlertId matches a fired alert's ruleId — the E5 evidence-totality walk terminating at facts. Pure test card.

tasks.title: Plain-language patient summary with denylist
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/patient-summary.ts per S13: SUMMARY_DENYLIST (raw mg/score numerics; diagnose/treat/prescribe directive verbs) and generatePatientSummary(patientId, regimen, adherenceSummary, forecasts, openTasks, clock). Adherence note in plain dose-count English; refill reminders in DAYS only (never mg); only caregiver-follow-up and patient-education tasks surface to patients; every emitted string is checked against the denylist and a violation THROWS. Tests: adherence sentence present, at-risk reminder present, clinician-review tasks hidden, injected raw score throws.

tasks.title: Patient-summary denylist negative tests
tasks.prompt: Add test/patient-summary-denylist.test.ts: table-drive the SUMMARY_DENYLIST patterns — '3.5 risk', '500 mg', 'we will diagnose', 'take as prescribed' all match; 'contact your pharmacy', 'you took 4 of 10 doses', 'your care team has been notified' all pass. Also assert generatePatientSummary throws for a directive-verb task description. Pure test card.

tasks.title: Five seeded patient fixtures
tasks.prompt: Create src/fixtures/patients.ts with the five S14 patients as plain typed objects: A combo-pill MIN + standalone APAP (dup-ingredient after decomposition), B amoxicillin allergy vs cephalexin/aztreonam prescriptions, C APAP 1500mg qid overdose, D weight recorded in lb with an mg/kg order, E moderate DDI pair destined for always-for-pair suppression. Export PATIENT_FIXTURES keyed a-e with facts + regimen per patient, every date a fixed UTC ISO string.

tasks.title: Adversarial E4 scenario fixtures
tasks.prompt: Create src/fixtures/adversarial-scenarios.ts re-exporting the E4 cases as named constants that reference PATIENT_FIXTURES: COMBO_PILL_BLIND_SPOT (patient a), BETA_LACTAM_DIVERGENCE (b), UNIT_TRAP_OVERDOSE (c and d), FREE_TEXT_GHOST (the 'a water pill' + 'a blood-thinner' reconciliation inputs), ALERT_FATIGUE_REPLAY (e), HELD_MEDICATION_RECONCILIATION and REFILL_CLIFF_WITH_PAUSE (data for s25-style asserts). Each constant carries a description string naming the invariant it stresses.

tasks.title: Flagship integration test over seeded patients
tasks.prompt: Create test/integration.test.ts wiring S01-S31 together over PATIENT_FIXTURES: patient a fires dup-ingredient (MIN decomposition proof); b gets moderate for cephalexin and informational for aztreonam; c fires max-dose; d evaluates without UnitMismatchError; e's moderate DDI records an always-for-pair suppression and isSuppressed flips true while a contraindicated suppression attempt throws; every alert has evidence.length >= 1; reconciliation of 'a water pill' lands unmatched; the whole suite is identical across two consecutive runs with the same FixedClock.
preconditions: all rule cards, suppression, reconciliation, and fixtures merged (s15/s16/s20/s31)
acceptanceChecks: all five patients produce their expected alert profile
suppression replay demotes the moderate DDI and refuses the contraindicated one
npm test green with zero network calls

tasks.title: Therapeutic-class breadth in the ReferencePack
tasks.prompt: Worked example A, card 1: extend FIXTURE_REFERENCE_PACK.therapeuticClasses with five more classes — beta-blocker, ACE-inhibitor, statin, benzodiazepine, proton-pump-inhibitor — each with two illustrative member ingredient ids added to the rxnorm fixture graph if missing. Update test/reference-pack.test.ts to assert therapeuticClasses.length >= 7.

tasks.title: Duplicate-class breadth patient fixtures
tasks.prompt: Worked example A, card 2: add three more patient fixtures (two statins, two beta-blockers, two benzodiazepines) to src/fixtures/patients.ts under keys f, g, h. Widen the fixture record type accordingly; each regimen uses the class members introduced in s33. Assertion of dup-class firing lands in s35, not here — this card only ships importable, type-checking fixtures.

tasks.title: Same-class duplication property test
tasks.prompt: Worked example A, card 3: add test/rule-engine-property.test.ts — with the seeded LCG, draw 20 random same-class pairs from FIXTURE_REFERENCE_PACK.therapeuticClasses (classes with >= 2 members) and assert checkClassDuplication fires at least one dup-class alert naming that class for every pair. Deterministic seed 42.

tasks.title: Audit-log projections for queue and calendar
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/audit-projections.ts: projectTaskCounts(auditLog) and projectAdherenceRecordCounts(auditLog) fold the append-only event stream into per-patient counts ('task-created' and 'adherence-recorded' respectively) — the E3 principle that queues and calendars are PROJECTIONS over the log, never parallel state. Tests: three appended events project to the right per-patient counts and re-projection is idempotent.

tasks.title: Knowledge-debt ledger
tasks.prompt: Create docs/knowledge-debt.md: a table of live debts with columns item / risk / trigger-that-forces-resolution / expert-review-needed. Seed it with: illustrative ReferencePack content (FDB/Medi-Span licensing + pharmacist sign-off), beta-lactam cross-reactivity table (allergist review), NDC mapping ambiguity, renal/hepatic/pregnancy dose adjustment placeholders, regulatory scope-of-practice boundary (decision support, never diagnosis), and fixture-graph coverage limits. The ledger gates claims: nothing is 'clinically validated' until its row is signed off.
tasks.knowledgeDebt: The ledger itself is the debt register; keeping it current is a standing obligation on every card that touches reference data.

tasks.title: LASA confusable-name surfacing rule
tasks.prompt: Create src/core/rules/lasa.ts: checkLookAlikeSoundAlike(regimen, pack) surfaces an informational, passive 'lasa' alert when two ACTIVE items' concept display names differ by a small edit distance (<= 2 over names longer than 8 chars, computed with a local Levenshtein — no dependencies). Evidence names both drugs. Test with the classic hydrOXYzine/hydrALAZINE-style fixture pair added locally in the test.

tasks.title: FHIR-shaped import adapter over fixtures
tasks.prompt: Create src/adapters/fhir-import.ts: a deterministic adapter mapping a FHIR R4 MedicationRequest subset ({ status, intent, medicationText, dosageInstruction: { timing: { frequency, period, periodUnit }, doseQuantity: { value, unit } }, dispenseRequest: { quantityMg, numberOfRepeatsAllowed } }) into ReconciliationItem + RegimenItem via the concept resolver. on-hold => status held; unknown text flows through as unresolved (conceptId null). No network, fixture objects only. Tests: an active order maps to an active RegimenItem; on-hold maps to held; free-text medication lands unresolved.
tasks.knowledgeDebt: Only a MedicationRequest subset is mirrored (no MedicationStatement/AllergyIntolerance, no route/asNeeded); the adapter interface is the extension point for real FHIR later.

tasks.title: Repository README and architecture notes
tasks.prompt: Write README.md: what the platform is (decision support, not diagnosis), the four architectural layers (clinical facts / rule evaluation / workflow state / presentation), the determinism rules (injected Clock, fixture ReferencePack, append-only audit), how to run npm test, and pointers to docs/knowledge-debt.md. Keep it under 60 lines; no marketing language.

import type { MedicationConceptId, RxNormNode } from '../core/types.js';

const id = (v: string) => v as unknown as MedicationConceptId;

export const FIXTURE_RXNORM_GRAPH: RxNormNode[] = [
	{ rxcui: id('rx-flx-in'), termType: 'IN', name: 'Fluoxetine', parentRxcuis: [] },
	{ rxcui: id('rx-flx-pin'), termType: 'PIN', name: 'Fluoxetine Hydrochloride', parentRxcuis: [id('rx-flx-in')] },
	{ rxcui: id('rx-flx-scd'), termType: 'SCD', name: 'Fluoxetine 20 MG Oral Capsule', parentRxcuis: [id('rx-flx-in')], ingredients: [id('rx-flx-in')] },
	{ rxcui: id('rx-prozac'), termType: 'SBD', name: 'Prozac 20 MG Oral Capsule', parentRxcuis: [id('rx-flx-scd')], ingredients: [id('rx-flx-in')] },
	{ rxcui: id('rx-apap-in'), termType: 'IN', name: 'Acetaminophen', parentRxcuis: [] },
	{ rxcui: id('rx-apap-scd'), termType: 'SCD', name: 'Acetaminophen 500 MG Oral Tablet', parentRxcuis: [id('rx-apap-in')], ingredients: [id('rx-apap-in')] },
	{ rxcui: id('rx-tylenol'), termType: 'SBD', name: 'Tylenol 500 MG Oral Tablet', parentRxcuis: [id('rx-apap-scd')], ingredients: [id('rx-apap-in')] },
	{ rxcui: id('ndc-50580-449-05'), termType: 'NDC', name: '50580-449-05', parentRxcuis: [id('rx-apap-scd')] },
	{ rxcui: id('rx-hyd-in'), termType: 'IN', name: 'Hydrocodone', parentRxcuis: [] },
	{ rxcui: id('rx-hyd-scd'), termType: 'SCD', name: 'Hydrocodone 5 MG Oral Tablet', parentRxcuis: [id('rx-hyd-in')], ingredients: [id('rx-hyd-in')] },
	{ rxcui: id('rx-apap-hyd-min'), termType: 'MIN', name: 'Acetaminophen / Hydrocodone', parentRxcuis: [], ingredients: [id('rx-apap-in'), id('rx-hyd-in')] },

# Knowledge-debt ledger

Nothing in this repository may be described as clinically validated until its row below is signed off by the named expert role.

| Item | Risk | Trigger that forces resolution | Expert review needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| ReferencePack content is an illustrative subset | Rules fire on toy data; real coverage unknown | Any deployment beyond dev-test | Pharmacist + licensed source (FDB/Medi-Span) |
| Beta-lactam side-chain cross-reactivity table | Over/under-warning on allergy alerts | First real allergy-alert consumer | Allergist |
| NDC-to-RxCUI mapping ambiguity (obsolete/repackaged codes) | Silent mis-resolution of dispensed packages | Import adapter fed real NDC data | Pharmacist / terminology service |
| Renal, hepatic, pregnancy, and age dose adjustment | Ceilings wrong for high-risk patients | Any dose ceiling consumed clinically | Pharmacist + lab integration (eGFR) |
| Scope-of-practice boundary | Generated text read as diagnosis/treatment | Every patient-facing string change | Clinical-legal review |
| Fixture RxNorm graph coverage | Resolver blind spots outside 17 nodes | Any new drug family in fixtures | Terminology curator |

files.content:
# Clinical Medication Safety and Adherence Platform

Decision-support foundation for outpatient medication safety: reconciliation with provenance, evidence-bearing interaction/allergy/dose rules, suppression memory with a severity ceiling, adherence and refill projections, and a plain-language patient summary. It is NOT a diagnostic or prescribing system.

## Layers

- src/core/types.ts + fixtures: clinical facts (typed, branded ids)
- src/core/rules/* + rule-engine.ts: rule evaluation (pure, evidence-bearing)
- src/core/{reconciliation,suppression-store,task-queue,audit-log}.ts: workflow state (append-only audit)
- src/core/patient-summary.ts: presentation (denylist-guarded plain language)

## Determinism

- All time flows through the injected Clock (src/core/clock.ts); no Date.now() in production modules.
- All reference data is the versioned fixture pack (src/fixtures/reference-pack.ts); no live drug-database calls.
- Audit events are append-only; queues and calendars are projections over the log.

## Run

    npm test

Zero network. Seeded patients live in src/fixtures/patients.ts; open debts in docs/knowledge-debt.md.

behavior.content: Status of the medication-safety build: the foundation slice (types, clock, dose arithmetic, RxNorm fixture graph, concept resolver, reference pack, audit log) is merged. The five safety rules and the evaluateRules facade are implemented with evidence-bearing alerts; suppression memory enforces the contraindication ceiling with audit provenance and expiry. Reconciliation preserves totality with blocking unmatched items; adherence and refill projections run on the injected clock; the task queue traces every task to facts and evidence; the patient summary is denylist-guarded. Remaining: breadth cards (class breadth, LASA, FHIR-shaped import) and the flagship integration gate (s32). npm test is green and fully deterministic — no network, no wall-clock reads.

tracks.provenance: Authored happy-path baseline (Claude design-time spec, 2026-07-10).

behavior.content: This project is a clinical medication safety and adherence platform: reconciliation with source provenance, an evidence-bearing rule engine (duplicate ingredient, class duplication, max dose, allergy cross-reactivity, contraindication), suppression memory with a severity ceiling, adherence and refill forecasting on an injected clock, and a plain-language patient summary that never emits raw scores or clinical directives. Everything runs against versioned deterministic fixtures — it is decision support, not diagnosis or prescribing.
